title: 31 Mining Contracts Turned The Seabed Into A Race
hook: The seabed rush has already reached 31 contracts.
closing: Mining the shared ocean floor could lock in consequences for everyone.
question: Should seabed mining pause?

segments.say: Seabed mining reached 31 exploration contracts. The race is no longer hypothetical.
Seabed nodules hold 44 million tonnes of cobalt. That concentration makes the ocean floor a strategic prize.
A mining pause has support from 37 countries. Opposition is rising alongside the rush.
